query:
query ($identifier: bytea!) @cached(ttl: 5) {
    
    message_view(
      
      where: {send_occurred_at: {_is_null: false}, msg_id: {_eq: $identifier}},
      
      limit: 1
    ) {
      

  id
  msg_id
  nonce
  sender
  recipient
  is_delivered
  is_provisional
  send_occurred_at
  delivery_occurred_at
  delivery_latency
  origin_chain_id
  origin_block_height
  origin_domain_id
  origin_tx_id
  origin_tx_hash
  origin_tx_sender
  origin_tx_recipient
  destination_chain_id
  destination_domain_id
  destination_tx_id
  destination_tx_hash
  destination_tx_sender
  destination_tx_recipient
  message_body

  origin_block_hash
  origin_block_id
  origin_mailbox
  origin_tx_cumulative_gas_used
  origin_tx_effective_gas_price
  origin_tx_gas_limit
  origin_tx_gas_price
  origin_tx_gas_used
  origin_tx_max_fee_per_gas
  origin_tx_max_priority_fee_per_gas
  origin_tx_nonce
  destination_block_hash
  destination_block_height
  destination_block_id
  destination_mailbox
  destination_tx_cumulative_gas_used
  destination_tx_effective_gas_price
  destination_tx_gas_limit
  destination_tx_gas_price
  destination_tx_gas_used
  destination_tx_max_fee_per_gas
  destination_tx_max_priority_fee_per_gas
  destination_tx_nonce
  total_gas_amount
  total_payment
  num_payments

    }
  }
